backend/main.mo: Main actor for a social media backend implementing posts, comments, messaging, notifications, follow system, and friend requests with access control and blob storage mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that upgrades actor state from an older schema to a new schema by adding `friendRequests` and `friendCount` fields while preserving all existing data.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two implemented features: React Query hooks for the friend system in useQueries.ts and a dynamic friend request button UI on UserProfilePage.tsx.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose and recent changes, serving as a reference for the frontend codebase.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining light and dark OKLCH CSS custom properties for the app's color system including backgrounds, borders, charts, and sidebar tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that sets the page title to 'Smileup' and mounts the React app via src/main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that wraps the app with ThemeProvider, InternetIdentityProvider, and QueryClientProvider, showing a loading splash, LandingPage for unauthenticated users, or the full router for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/AvatarPlaceholde: Reusable avatar component that renders a profile picture from an ExternalBlob URL or falls back to gradient initials, supporting multiple sizes and both legacy and new prop naming conventions.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Renders a fixed bottom navigation bar with icons for Home, Explore, ShortSport, Messages, Create, and Profile routes, highlighting the active route and showing a dot indicator when conversations exist.
frontend/src/components/CommentsSheet.ts: A bottom sheet component that displays a post's comments with loading skeletons and allows authenticated users to submit new comments via a text input form.
frontend/src/components/editor/AudioPane: An editor panel for managing audio tracks, supporting file upload and microphone recording, with per-track volume sliders, mute toggles, and removal controls.
frontend/src/components/editor/DesignPan: A React panel component for editing canvas design properties including aspect ratio, background color/gradient presets, shape overlays, and decorative elements. Exposes controls that update the shared EditorState via an onUpdate callback.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorCan: A canvas-based preview component that renders the current editor state including background color, text layers, sticker layers, filter CSS, vignette gradient, glitch, and letterbox effects using the HTML5 Canvas API.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorTim: A timeline UI component that displays a time ruler, a video track with draggable/removable clips, and a playhead scrubber, allowing users to navigate time and manage clips including adding blank clips.
frontend/src/components/editor/EffectsPa: A panel component for toggling visual motion-graphics effects (e.g., glitch, confetti, letterbox) on the editor state, displaying active effects as tags and available effects as a grid of toggle buttons.
frontend/src/components/editor/ExportPan: A panel component for exporting and sharing a video clip, providing title/description metadata fields, a video preview, a download button that triggers a blob URL download, and a placeholder share button.
frontend/src/components/editor/FiltersPa: A panel component for applying and fine-tuning video filter settings via preset buttons (e.g., Moody, Noir, Cinematic) and individual sliders for brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, vignette, and other parameters.
frontend/src/components/editor/StickersP: A panel component for adding and managing emoji sticker layers on a video editor, supporting categorized emoji selection, placement, size/rotation controls, and deletion of stickers.
frontend/src/components/editor/TextPanel: A panel component for adding and editing text layers in a video editor, with controls for font, color, size, alignment, bold/italic, animation, and timing.
frontend/src/components/editor/Transitio: A panel component displaying a library of video transition effects and allowing users to apply specific transitions between consecutive clips in the editor.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that wraps all pages with a TopBar, a router Outlet for page content, and a BottomNav.
frontend/src/components/NotificationsPan: Displays a dropdown panel of user notifications (follows, messages) with avatars, relative timestamps, and unread indicators, marking them read on click and navigating to the relevant route.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: Renders a single social post card with author info, media (image or video), like/comment/view/bookmark actions, optimistic like updates, and intersection-observer-based view recording.
A dialog modal that shows a grid of the current user's posts as thumbnails, allowing them to select one to share as a Shortspot.
frontend/src/components/StoriesRow.tsx: Horizontally scrollable stories row showing the current user's 'Add Story' button and mock story items, opening a StoryViewerModal when a story is tapped.
frontend/src/components/StoryViewerModal: A full-screen modal component for viewing a single story, displaying the user's avatar, name, handle, timestamp, and a progress bar. Closes on Escape key press or backdrop click.
frontend/src/components/TopBar.tsx: A sticky top navigation bar showing the Smileup wordmark, notification bell with unread count, search button, and sign-out button. Hides on the '/shortsport' route and manages a notifications panel dropdown.
frontend/src/components/TrendingProfiles: A horizontally scrollable section displaying trending creator profile cards from mock data, each showing rank, avatar, follower/post counts, and a follow button.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: A card component for displaying a video post with thumbnail, play button, duration badge, like/comment/share/bookmark actions, and a double-tap like animation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flow, and identity persistence across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: A collection of React Query hooks wrapping backend actor calls for profiles, posts, comments, notifications, messages, and social features like friends and follows.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind CSS, imports Inter and Syne fonts, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes using OKLCH color values, and adds utility classes for glassmorphism, scrollbar hiding, and gradient text effects.
frontend/src/lib/mockData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and mock data arrays for Posts, Comments, Users, Stories, Messages, and Conversations used as placeholder data throughout the frontend.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Provides utility functions: `cn` for merging Tailwind class names, `formatNumber` for K/M abbreviations, `formatTime` for seconds-to-mm:ss, and `timeAgo` for relative timestamps.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in TanStack QueryClientProvider and a custom InternetIdentityProvider for ICP authentication.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePostPage.tsx: Page component for creating a new post, supporting file upload or URL input for photo/video/GIF/poster media types, with caption input and submission via the `useCreatePost` mutation hook.
frontend/src/pages/EditorPage.tsx: Full-featured video/design editor page with a multi-panel toolbar (upload, trim, filters, effects, stickers, design) and shared editor state types including clips, text layers, sticker layers, audio tracks, and filter settings.
frontend/src/pages/ExplorePage.tsx: Explore page with a debounced search input and tabs to switch between searching posts (filtered client-side) and users (via `useSearchUsers` hook), displaying results in a scrollable list.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Displays the main social feed with stories, trending profiles, and a chronologically sorted list of posts. Handles loading skeletons, error states, empty states, and opens a comments sheet on post interaction.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Unauthenticated landing page for Smileup that shows a branded login button using Internet Identity. Includes a tagline, feature highlights, and a footer with attribution.
frontend/src/pages/MessagesPage.tsx: Full messaging UI with a conversation list sidebar and a message thread view, supporting text messages and shared post previews. Includes unread counts, auto-scroll, and a post picker modal.
frontend/src/pages/MessageThreadPage.tsx: Thin wrapper page that extracts a principalId route param and renders MessagesPage with that principal pre-selected as the initial conversation.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Authenticated user profile page showing avatar, stats (followers/following), and a grid of the user's posts. Supports inline profile editing, avatar upload, and opening a comments sheet on post tap.
frontend/src/pages/ShortSportPage.tsx: TikTok-style vertical video reel page that filters posts to video-only, plays the active reel via IntersectionObserver, and supports mute toggle, like actions with optimistic updates, and auto-scroll.
frontend/src/pages/UserProfilePage.tsx: React page displaying a user's profile with their posts grid, follow/unfollow controls, and a dynamic friend action button that adapts based on current friendship status (none, pending outgoing/incoming, or friends).
frontend/src/routeTree.ts: Defines and exports the TanStack Router route tree, mapping all app paths (feed, explore, editor, profile, messages, user profiles by principal or handle) to their corresponding page components.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing helper functions to read URL query parameters from both standard and hash-based routing, persist them in sessionStorage, and clean sensitive params from the URL bar.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based color tokens, typography/container-query/animate plugins, custom fonts, border radii, and shadow utilities.
project_state.json: Project state manifest tracking the Smileup social media app's existing features, pending feature requests (friend system, friend zone page, DMs, sharing), architectural notes, and known issues.
